items.name: Checkbox
items.note: Replace. The input is a sibling of the label, not nested inside it; pair them with for/id. Help text goes in a form-text below. One exception, inside a menu item (FRM-11): the input is nested in the label so the whole row is the hit target, and it drops .check-sm. UNRESOLVED - whether the nested form is permitted or the menu item should carry for/id like every other checkbox.

items.name: Combobox
items.note: Replace. Multi-select filter: the toggle shows the label and the selection (“Language: 2 selected”), the menu holds one checkbox per value, and a .combobox-search input appears once the list passes six entries. One control for every filter: single-value filters carry radio items, multi-value filters checkbox items, and the toggle always reads label plus value. Replaces the native select the product used before (FRM-2, retired), including the Sort by control. Two deviations to settle: the checkbox is nested inside label.menu-item rather than paired by for/id (see FRM-9), and it resets --bs-theme-bg / --bs-theme-contrast because a themed .menu parent would otherwise paint the unchecked box in the menu's own fill.

items.name: Toast
items.note: Added. Confirms a reversible action and carries the Undo. States what happened and the count; does not auto-dismiss while an action is on it. Takes the Bootstrap status theme for the outcome - theme-success here - with an icon beside the text, never colour alone. Used on Subscribers after Unsubscribe.

items.name: Progress
items.note: Direct. The role and aria-value attributes move to the outer .progress in v6; the bar keeps only its width. Shown while a file uploads, then replaced by the file row. The fill is Bootstrap blue-600 through --bs-progress-bar-bg, not the user primary.

items.name: Popover
items.note: Added. Carries the filters that do not fit the bar. No popover-header - the button that opens it already names it. Body is a single column of full-width Comboboxes (SF-3); the trigger shows a count of applied filters inside. No Apply button - every filter applies on change, and the popover closes on outside click.

items.name: Subheader band
items.note: Replace. Tint derives from the per-user primary, not a fixed green. Three zones. The home icon sits alone in a chevron-clipped block on --bs-primary-bg-muted and turns solid primary with a white glyph on hover; the breadcrumb sits on the band tint; from the slanted divider onwards the band lightens (primary-bg-subtle mixed 45% with the body) and runs behind the tabs and the mode pill (FRM-8). The band never widens the page — the tab strip is the only part that scrolls.

items.name: Search and filter bar
items.note: Custom composition of FRM-1, FRM-3, SF-2, SF-3 and MSG-8. Search, up to three inline filters, the rest behind a More filters popover, sorting last, count on its own row. Takes its filters, rows and search fields as props and hands the filtered rows back to the page. Inline filter count drops with width: three above 880px, two from 740px, one from 600px, none below.

flags.text: Full example lives in Search and filter.dc.html, which was not shared. Built from Input (FRM-1), Input group (FRM-3), Popover (SF-2), Combobox (SF-3) and Chip (MSG-8).
